name: Froxel-diagonal inverse-square bias
definition: A technique to bound the near-field spike of a point or spot light's inverse square attenuation in volumetric fog by adding a bias term to the denominator, preventing extreme aliasing and jitter artifacts when samples land very close to the light source.
summary: Froxel-diagonal inverse-square bias prevents near-field aliasing in volumetric fog by adding a bias scaled to the froxel's diagonal length, unlike fixed-floor methods.
